title: Rollyson Brazilian Jiu Jitsu

services.name: No-Gi BJJ
services.desc: Perfect for adults and teens (ages 13 and older) who are just starting Brazilian Jiu Jitsu or need to brush up on the basics. It focuses on the foundations of BJJ and self-defense - positions, escapes, and the core movements every higher belt is built

services.name: HIIT Circuit
services.desc: HIIT stands for High-Intensity Interval Training - a circuit of high-intensity exercises with short rest periods in between, repeated to complete a full workout. Build the gas tank and engine that carry your jiu-jitsu into the deep

services.name: Vic's Striking Class
services.desc: Improves striking skills, speed, and footwork. For adults, it includes bag and pad work as well as light sparring; for kids, it includes bag and pad work. A perfect complement to your grappling and a complete stand-up
